subject: DPA and transfer-risk remediation for FinPay — SCCs / UK IDTA path forward
messages:
From: Sara Lin <sara.lin@finpay.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: FinPay Legal <legal@finpay.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:12:34 -0800
Subject: Initial DPA questions + SCCs

Priyom — great to meet on the call earlier. We had two items that need clarification before our legal team signs:

1) Our EU counsel wants explicit fallback language if SCCs are deemed insufficient — can Redwood commit to either (A) UK IDTA addendum or (B) a documented transfer impact assessment and mitigation plan?
2) Subprocessor list & notification cadence: FinPay needs 30 days' notice for new subprocessors that may process EU data.

I've attached a checklist our counsel asked us to complete (FinPay_SCCs_checklist.xlsx). Can you loop in your legal/ops and let us know the expected execution path (DocuSign vs AdobeSign) and timeline?

Thanks — Sara
Sara Lin
Head of Data Privacy, FinPay Solutions
(sara.lin@finpay.com)

Attachment: FinPay_SCCs_checklist.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lin <sara.lin@finpay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 11:03:10 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial DPA questions + SCCs

Sara — thanks for the checklist and the clear asks. Quick responses below; I'll follow up with proposed redlines attached.

1) Transfer fallback: Redwood is prepared to offer a UK IDTA addendum (where applicable) OR provide a documented transfer-impact mitigation package. We prefer the IDTA where the customer requests it — that short-circuits ambiguity.
2) Subprocessors: our standard is 30 days' notice for material subprocessors and immediate notice for high-risk changes. We can align to FinPay's 30-day requirement.

Next steps: attaching our current DPA with in-line redlines (Redwood_DPA_v3_redlines.pdf). Karthik, can you confirm whether Legal is comfortable with committing to the IDTA option and whether we should route execution via DocuSign (preferred) or support AdobeSign for procurement?

Priyom
Priyom Das
Head of Legal Operations, Redwood Inference
Attachment: Redwood_DPA_v3_redlines.pdf (redlines PDF stub)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 23 Nov 2026 08:27:45 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial DPA questions + SCCs

Priyom / team — quick internal note: legal is OK with the dual-path approach (IDTA or documented mitigation). A few clarifications before we promise the IDTA:

- We need to confirm which FinPay entities (legal entity list) want the IDTA vs standard DPA. Sometimes the sales team scopes everything to a parent company and then downstream entities sign the standard DPA.
- For the IDTA, we can't add additional processor obligations beyond our baseline — we can provide the addendum and the transfer-impact narrative we maintain internally.

On esign: DocuSign is our default and integrates with our contract tracking. We can support AdobeSign for this customer if procurement requires it, but that will add 24-48 hours to our standard execution SLA (internal routing).

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
VP, Legal & Compliance, Redwood Inference

From: Oliver Grant <oliver.grant@lawfirm-bridge.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Sara Lin <sara.lin@finpay.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 14:05:02 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial DPA questions + SCCs

Folks — attaching a short draft UK-IDTA addendum for consideration (UK-IDTA-addendum-draft.docx). A couple of practical points from counsel:

- The addendum should reference the primary DPA version by name/date to avoid ambiguity.
- We recommend a clause stating Redwood will provide transfer-impact documentation within 10 business days of request and will maintain evidence in a secure folder for audit.
- Suggest keeping subprocessor notice at 30 days; any accelerated notice requests will be handled case-by-case with potential carve-outs for emergency security fixes.

If useful, I can join a 30-minute call with FinPay Legal this week to walk through redlines live.

Oliver Grant
Associate, Bridge & Co. (external counsel for FinPay)
Attachment: UK-IDTA-addendum-draft.docx (draft addendum)

Sara — thanks for the checklist and Oliver for the draft addendum. From an ops/onboarding perspective, a few items we want to surface before DocuSign:

- Evidence package: we'll upload a transfer-impact assessment (redacted) and our subprocessors registry snapshot to the shared Drive folder. That will speed sign-off.
- Execution: we'll prepare the DocuSign envelope. Can you confirm the signatories (name + title + email) for FinPay Legal so we ensure correct routing?
- Timeline: if FinPay needs AdobeSign, let us know by EOD Thursday; otherwise we'll proceed with DocuSign and expect signature within 3 business days after routing.

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
